newsitem.title: USA: Medical Dynamics to buy dental software co.
newsitem.headline: Medical Dynamics to buy dental software co.

text.p: Medical Dynamics Inc said Tuesday that it has signed a non-binding Letter of Intent to acquire Computer Age Dentist Inc a supplier of practice management software to the dental industry.
Terms of the transaction call for Medical Dynamics to issue an undisclosed combination of cash, notes and common stock in exchange for 100 percent of privately-owned Computer Age Dentist.

"The combined MEDY/CADI entity should generate revenue in excess of $3.5 million, based on the companies' respective fiscal year-end results from September 30, 1996," said Van Horsley, chief executive officer of Medical Dynamics in a press release.
The company said it expects the transaction to close around September 30.
